changelog:
Initial release of service-dependency-mapper.

- Auto-discovers and maps service dependencies from code, config files, and runtime/running data.
- Generates dependency graphs and architecture visualizations (Mermaid, DOT, PlantUML, D2).
- Identifies critical paths and single points of failure.
- Assesses blast radius and user impact for each service.
- Provides commands for discovery, blast radius analysis, visualization, and architecture health assessment.
